findings.problem: hPZ and hQZ each run the same three-step calc, once for PDiag and once for QDiag. The calc rewrites map (f ≫ k) as map k ∘ map f via map_comp, congr_hom and erw comp_apply. It then uses the colimit-equality witness (hP or hQ). It then rewrites back with the symmetric map_comp. That is about 19 lines per copy, the copies differ only in the diagram, and each calc contains the same map_comp/erw step twice.
findings.proposed_change: Add one private lemma and use it twice. Statement: for M : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing (ADiag A x), m : M.obj U, n : M.obj V, f : U ⟶ W, g : V ⟶ W, h : M.presheaf.map f m = M.presheaf.map g n, and k : W ⟶ Z, we have M.presheaf.map (f ≫ k) m = M.presheaf.map (g ≫ k) n. Proof: map_comp twice, via ConcreteCategory.congr_hom and comp_apply once. Then rewrite the paired steps as hPZ := lemma (PDiag A P x) fP gP hP kP, with F and G unfolded by reassociation. hQZ is the same with hQ after `rw [hFQ, hGQ]`. The same lemma also covers the later TDiag step.
findings.benefit: This removes about 30 lines of copy-paste containing erw. It states the transport-along-a-further-arrow fact once, so the P and Q branches visibly parallel each other. Any change to the comp_apply/erw workaround is then made in one place.

findings.problem: backwardSetNative is by definition backwardSet at the same arguments, since MC A x P is a defeq abbrev of PStalk A P x. The additive native lemmas (backwardSetNative_add_left and _add_right) are one-line `exact` wrappers around the non-native versions. The smul native lemmas instead re-prove the whole statement. Each one repeats the jointly_surjective₃' decomposition, the germ rewrites, and the a • p ⊗ q = (a • p) ⊗ q or p ⊗ (a • q) argument. In the right-hand case this includes the explicit `change` and `TensorProduct.tmul_smul`. The same reasoning therefore sits in backwardSet_smul_left (249–263) and backwardSet_smul_right (265–282), and again in the _native versions.
findings.proposed_change: Keep a single proof of each smul lemma. Either state the first set directly over A.stalk x and PStalk, or turn the native ones into wrappers like the add lemmas: `exact backwardSet_smul_left A P Q x r m n` and `exact backwardSet_smul_right A P Q x r m n`. The pure-tensor identity can instead be factored as a private lemma `tmul_smul_germ` (nativeTensorGerm U ((a • p) ⊗ₜ q) = ιR a • nativeTensorGerm U (p ⊗ₜ q), and the symmetric statement) used by both. The cast through `(cA A x).pt` versus `A.stalk x` is a defeq (`colimitCommRing` is `inferInstanceAs`). I have not checked that the `exact` elaborates, but the same defeq already makes `backwardSetNative_add_left` work.
findings.benefit: This removes about 30 duplicated lines. The two smul facts are proved once instead of four times, so a future change to the stalk-module instance or to `ModuleColimit` needs one edit.
